scripts.build:dev: npm run build:client:dev && npm run build:server && npm run generate:static
scripts.build:prd: npm run build:client:prd && npm run build:server && npm run generate:static
scripts.deploy:dev: aws s3 sync dist/ s3://$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /${SITE_ENV:-dev}/${SITE_DOMAIN}/s3/frontend_site --query Parameter.Value --output text) --delete
scripts.deploy:prd: aws s3 sync dist/ s3://$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /prd/${SITE_DOMAIN}/s3/frontend_site --query Parameter.Value --output text) --delete
scripts.invalidate:dev: aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws ssm get-parameter --name /dev/${SITE_DOMAIN}/cloudfront/frontend_distribution_id --query Parameter.Value --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.invalidate:prd: aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws ssm get-parameter --name /prd/${SITE_DOMAIN}/cloudfront/frontend_distribution_id --query Parameter.Value --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.publish:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run deploy:dev && npm run invalidate:dev
scripts.publish:prd: npm run build:prd && npm run deploy:prd && npm run invalidate:prd
